title: Application to Study Permit Process Steps for Sweden
notice: 1 SEK ≈ 10 BDT. Proof of funds (102,816 SEK) is your own living money shown via bank statement — it is NOT a blocked deposit like Norway. Study permit fee: 1,000 SEK (~10,000 BDT).

processSteps.label: University Application : via universityadmissions.se (deadline Jan 15 for Autumn, Aug 15 for Spring)
bullets: Application fee: 900 SEK (~9,000 BDT) — covers all program choices in one cycle
You can select up to 4 programs ranked by priority

processSteps.label: Offer / Admission Letter
bullets: Non-EU/EEA students: tuition fees 80,000–180,000 SEK/year (8,00,000–18,00,000 BDT) depending on program
Check if your program offers a tuition waiver or university scholarship

processSteps.label: Arrange Proof of Funds : 102,816 SEK (~10,28,000 BDT) in bank account
bullets: Required by Migrationsverket as proof of living funds for one academic year
This is shown via bank statement — no blocked deposit required
Amount is separate from tuition fee

processSteps.label: Arrange Accommodation : Student housing or private rental confirmation
bullets: Apply to student housing immediately after admission — queues fill fast
Student housing: 4,000–7,000 SEK/month; private: 8,000–14,000 SEK/month in Stockholm

processSteps.label: Migrationsverket Study Permit Application (online) : 1,000 SEK (~10,000 BDT)
bullets: Upload admission letter, bank statement, passport scan, accommodation proof

processSteps.label: VFS Global Dhaka Biometrics Appointment
bullets: Bring original passport, case reference number, and photo

costSteps.label: University Application Fee : 900 SEK (~9,000 BDT) — universityadmissions.se
Migrationsverket Study Permit Fee : 1,000 SEK (~10,000 BDT) — paid online
VFS Global Dhaka Service Fee : check vfsglobal.com for current rate
Tuition Fee : 80,000–180,000 SEK/year (8,00,000–18,00,000 BDT) — program dependent
Proof of Funds (bank statement) : 102,816 SEK (~10,28,000 BDT) — stays in your account
